purpose: Quantify how the Stage-A-confirmed semantically inadmissible nonpositive raw records affect phylogenetic-memory effects and the manuscript's central repeatability/portability conclusions.

cleaning_rule.rule: For these five traits only, raw numeric BIEN records with value <= 0 are excluded before the species median is calculated. All positive raw records and all records of the other seven traits are unchanged.
cleaning_rule.why_not_expand_to_12_after_outcome: Stage A predeclared five positive-only traits before raw audit results. The other seven traits are not retrospectively added to the cleaning rule. Stage A nevertheless found zero nonpositive raw records in those seven traits, so the frozen five-trait rule removes every observed nonpositive raw record in the 201-system population.

tree_contract.rule: Reconstruct each original frozen S3/prune crosswalk from the uncleaned admitted species list using the same V.PhyloMaker2 commit. Compute cleaned states from the frozen positive-only raw filter, then prune the already reconstructed tree to species retaining at least one admissible raw record. Do not rerun topology placement on the cleaned species subset.

reference_identity_gate.before_cleaning: Original S3 and prune rho must reproduce the archived v0.3 raw effects at four-decimal persistence precision for all 201 systems before cleaned effects are interpreted.
reference_identity_gate.nonpositive_counts: Original S3/prune nonpositive species counts must reproduce the Stage A / v0.3 counts exactly.

all_201_log_rule.rule: The cleaned-log analyses are interpreted only if all 201 systems retain >=20 species on both S3 and prune-only trees and all cleaned species medians are strictly positive by construction.

cleaned_raw: measurement-error-aware crossed meta-analysis with 500 two-way family x trait cluster-bootstrap refits
the same predeclared correlated-trait zero-family-effect null with 1000 replicates
cleaned_log_if_all_201_gate_passes: measurement-error-aware crossed meta-analysis with the same 500-refit uncertainty contract

impact_summary: Spearman and Pearson original-versus-cleaned rho across 201 systems
median, 90th percentile and maximum absolute rho change
number of systems with absolute rho change >=0.01, >=0.05, >=0.10

manuscript_decision_rule.if_all_201_support_retained: Because Stage A established inadmissible raw coding independently of memory outcomes, the cleaned positive-only extraction becomes the scientifically valid primary data contract for the next manuscript RC. The original unfiltered extraction is retained as an audit sensitivity, regardless of whether the central conclusion strengthens, weakens or remains unchanged.
manuscript_decision_rule.if_any_system_loses_support: Submission is HOLD. Do not silently drop the system. Re-scope the manuscript population prospectively before any replacement primary analysis.
manuscript_decision_rule.claim_stability_is_not_a_gate_for_cleani: Cleaning is justified by data validity, not by whether it preserves the current family-repeatability or weak-portability conclusions.

stop_rule: No alternative positivity threshold after outcomes.
No trait-specific exception for an observed zero.
No filtering based on delta rho or downstream manuscript impact.

execution_optimization.basis: Stage A identified 49 systems with at least one raw nonpositive record and 152 systems with none, without recomputing or inspecting rho changes.
execution_optimization.rule: Re-query and recompute cleaned states/effects only for the 49 Stage-A-contaminated systems. For the remaining 152 systems, the cleaned dataset is mathematically identical to the frozen v0.3 dataset, so copy their rho, bootstrap SE and log results directly from the immutable v0.3 reference artifact.
execution_optimization.identity_check: The final merged cleaned table must contain exactly 201 unique frozen family x trait systems. All inherited rows must be explicitly marked CLEAN_UNCHANGED_STAGE_A and must equal the v0.3 reference columns exactly.

scale_interpretation_rule.rule: Report cleaned raw and cleaned log memory results side by side. Do not choose one scale because it better preserves the current manuscript claim.
scale_interpretation_rule.if_concordant: The manuscript may state that the lineage-repeatability / trait-portability pattern is qualitatively robust to raw versus log trait dissimilarity, while retaining both numerical results.
scale_interpretation_rule.if_discordant: The manuscript must state that the biological inference is scale-dependent and must not use an unqualified title or abstract claim about lineage contingency or weak trait-level portability.
